checks.reason: At u1=u2=u3=0, delta'=1/100 and s=-1/10, all stated conditions hold. The normalization is (1-W)^9. From the exact arithmetic factors, its second coefficient is 36-81+36=-9, whereas the printed statement uses -Y_p=+9. The actual expansion 1-9p^(-8/5)+O(p^(-9/5)) and claimed remainder exponent -173/100 leave a discrepancy whose ratio to the allowed remainder grows as 18p^(13/100). This is an analytic asymptotic contradiction, not finite precision. The proof already uses +Y_p; convergence and the inspected leading-constant mechanism require first-order cancellation and magnitude, not the false sign. Minor is supported by that actual dependency boundary, not repair brevity.

The report retains RH and the additive-divisor conjecture, distinguishes leading asymptotic from a full lower-order polynomial, and explicitly excludes complete 63-page certification, all contour tails and lower residues. Code absence is not treated as a flaw; no author Maple code was run. Initial arithmetic execution and page-view facts are reused only under exact matching bindings, without claiming a new execution.
